nodes.title: SECURITY.md gets a table of Ennyn's principals and boundaries: the user, a contributor whose commit lands in a project, a cloned repository before the user trusts it, a package registry, the model reading project text, another plugin; each boundary with the part of Ennyn that guards it (commit-msg hook, deps check, side-copy hook, init-scan's escaping, config paths). The security reviewer and the audit name the lower-trust principal and the crossed boundary for every security finding; an effect only the user can cause on their own machine (their own environment variable, a git config they wrote) is a robustness note, not a security finding
nodes.source: review of cloudflare/security-audit-skill (MIT, c1c8a8c), 2026-10-25: 'require a boundary and result': the lower-trust principal, the accepted input, the intended control, the crossed boundary, the affected resource; same-principal authority and self-impact are not cross-boundary results. Several of Ennyn's open security and gate nodes are shapes only the user's own environment produces (ENNYN_CONFIG naming a pipe, trace2 targets in the user's git config)

nodes.title: A serious finding (🔴/🟠) goes to a fresh agent that did not find it and tries to refute it, re-reading every quoted line and running the check again, before the author fixes it: a confirmed one is fixed; a refuted one is recorded as rejected with why; one whose deciding fact is out of reach is needs-validation, with that exact fact, no severity, and a graph node. Convergence counts the refuted ones, so fixes of findings that were not real are measured
nodes.source: review of cloudflare/security-audit-skill (MIT, c1c8a8c), 2026-10-25: 'the agent that checks a finding is never the agent that found it'; three verdicts: confirmed, needs_validation (an exact unresolved fact, no severity) and rejected. Ennyn's evidence: fixes introduced more defects than first drafts missed (99 against 80 in the origin project; in Ennyn's cycles 2-10, 245 fix-introduced against 266 real escapes), and fixing a finding that was not real is pure risk

nodes.title: The security audit keeps a coverage ledger in the repository: one unit per group of the paths ennyn audit lists, times each attack class that applies, each planned, covered (the paths read and the checks run, named), candidate (finding ids), blocked (the exact missing fact), or deferred or out of scope with why; a zero-dependency validator checks it. The next audit starts from units never covered, deferred, blocked or whose files changed since; a final critic agent reads the ledger for unmapped entry points and parallel paths; the report claims 'audited' per unit only
nodes.source: review of cloudflare/security-audit-skill (MIT, c1c8a8c), 2026-10-25: the coverage ledger and validate-coverage-ledger.cjs are its coverage claim ('an architecture summary, agent count, or generic "auth reviewed" sentence is not coverage evidence'); runs are additive and changed source is revalidated; its README: in their test runs one run found about half of the vulnerabilities that repeated runs found in total. Ennyn's metrics log marks which cycles an audit covered, not which paths

nodes.title: finding-schema.md anchors each severity on the demonstrated result, in Ennyn's terms (for example: a gate silently lets through what it exists to refuse; a write leaves the project; a narrow shape or a condition the user sets; a wrong message or a valid input refused with a way around it), and says: a missing second layer where the first one holds is a hardening note, listed apart, never a reason for a round; no result stronger than the one observed is claimed; with no concrete damage the severity is lower than it feels
nodes.source: review of cloudflare/security-audit-skill (MIT, c1c8a8c), 2026-10-25: severity anchors with a high/medium test (does the result fully defeat an explicit control, or only weaken it?); defense-in-depth gaps are hardening notes. Ennyn's finding schema names four severities without defining them, while the cycle's rule 'a critical or high finding left after round two is still fixed' depends on them

nodes.title: A security audit takes the agent-context classes: every channel by which project text reaches the model (side-copy rules, the style, init-scan's JSON, the handoff, graph titles, reviewer probes) with who can write it, and every committed text that names a command something runs (the handoff's test and mutation commands, impact.referenceCommand, a graph module)

nodes.title: Before writing, every core task answers a smallest-change row by command: the line of the task that asks for each new piece (a piece no line asks for is left out and named in one line), what the repository already has for it (`git grep -w` of its names and verbs), the platform, git or an installed dependency that does it, and only then new code. Never cut: validation at trust boundaries, data-loss handling, security, accessibility, anything the task asks for. The row lives in impact-table.md, read on demand, not in text every session loads
nodes.source: review of ponytail (an open-source agent skill, MIT), 2026-10-25: its ladder (does it need to exist? already in this codebase? the platform? an installed dependency? one line? the minimum) cut delivered code 53% against the same agent with no skill, at the same hidden-check pass rate (39 tasks x 5 runs, Opus 5.5); its rung 'already in this codebase' came from duplicated code (its issue 217); bare 'follow YAGNI' prompts dropped safety guards (98.9% and 94.4% safe against 100%), hence the never-cut list; Ennyn's source grew from 5,593 lines (cycle 5) to 12,680 (cycle 11)

nodes.title: Copies a commit adds get a warning from the commit-msg hook that names where the other copy is: a top-level definition (function, class, exported constant) whose name, ignoring case, `_` and `-`, another tracked source file already defines, and a block of N or more meaningful lines (whitespace collapsed; blank, comment and brace lines skipped) that another tracked source file already holds. The same check runs over the cycle's whole range at its end, since rebase and cherry-pick run no commit-msg hook and parallel tasks cannot see each other's helpers; doctor counts the copies the tree holds. A helper rewritten under another name with other text is not found, and the warning says so
nodes.source: review of ponytail (an open-source agent skill, MIT), 2026-10-25: its band counts a new definition whose normalized name an existing one has as a duplicate rather than reuse (hooks/band/metrics.ts, duplicateOf); here the same reading becomes a gate, with no text loaded into the session. A throwaway scan of Ennyn at d326b04 (6-line windows): 4 copied blocks in 30 source files, among them isFile in setup/hook.mjs and setup/scan.mjs and the stdin and EPIPE handling of the Claude Code hooks

nodes.title: The cycle-end report lists where one decision lives in several places, read from history: a fix that adds the same lines to two or more files, and pairs of source files that change together in most commits touching either and are no declared impact.twins or review.cochange pair. The strongest becomes a graph node (one reader for that decision, or a declared twin when the copies answer different questions); copies that only look alike are left apart
nodes.source: user, 2026-10-25: a request; Ennyn's most recurring class is one decision read in two places that drift (reference-differentials, ~21 findings; fence-reader-shared; the settings reader unified in d326b04), while copied text is rare (duplicate-code); ponytail (MIT): merge near-copies that must change together, no abstraction with one implementation; impact-table.md S1: two different questions mean two predicates

nodes.title: The legacy audit also lists what the audited feature could lose: dead code, options no config sets, a hand-written reader the platform or git already gives, near-copies that must change together, each with its lines. A deletion lands in the same task only with the tests and the mutation pass green; a larger one becomes a node. Lean items are their own group: never counted as findings, never a reason for another review round

nodes.title: Conversation styles, en and tr: focused states an error as cause and fix only where the evidence shows the cause, else what is known and the check that would show it; a hedge that carries real uncertainty stays; after a third 'still broken' turn it stops patching, names the assumption that may be wrong and asks one diagnostic question; in both styles a reply about finished work ends with what was not checked or run and any risk. The bytes added are said in the cycle report; eval-first-cases measures them
nodes.source: review of i-have-adhd (an open-source agent skill, MIT; Ennyn's focused style follows its rules), 2026-10-25: its blind eval (Opus 4.8, 14 cases x 3 trials, evals/RESULTS.md) found one consistent regression, partial-success -0.63, a cause asserted without evidence, traced to its own 'cause, then fix' rule, which styles/focused.*.md holds too; its 'debug spiral' exception and pre-send check (a hedge that carries real uncertainty stays). ponytail (MIT): a blind judge preferred Ponytail 5's replies 110:67 over the previous version, mainly for the closing line on what was skipped or not checked

nodes.title: First eval cases, each with a passing and a failing reference: a bug reported on one caller of a shared function, counted fixed only when the shared function is (does the impact table's S1/S2 do what ponytail's root-cause rule did?); a multi-turn scenario in one resumed session (the style holds across a topic switch and after compaction, a push is asked before it runs, a third 'still broken' turn stops patching); the session's own tests run against mutants of the code it wrote (ennyn mutate), counting what they catch; an arm with the smallest-change row, judged on the lines it delivers and on the hidden safety checks, so a lean rule that drops a guard shows; the terse style is run beside normal on the same cases, so a correctness drop shows before it is offered

nodes.title: Where no deterministic check reads a case, a judge compares the arms blind: labels permuted per case from a digest of the case key (a resumed run gives the same labels), only a marked block of the rubric reaches it, a self-test gates it (it must rank a known-good outcome above a known-bad one), and the release rule is comparative: no blocker the baseline lacks, correctness and safety within 0.1 of baseline, a higher weighted score
nodes.source: review of i-have-adhd (an open-source agent skill, MIT), 2026-10-25: scripts/judge.py, evals/rubric.md; its absolute 'no blocking findings' rule could not pass while one broken case stayed in the set (evals/RESULTS.md); ponytail (MIT): its over-engineering and completeness judges must pass a self-test before they score
